summary: Iteration 137: ApprovalBillingModal Testing Complete - All features verified. Modal opens correctly from Aprobación action, shows 'Comprobante de Pago Anticipado' upload (marked Opcional), displays 'Instrucción de Facturación' table with consolidated items, auto-loads exchange rate from /exchange-rate/current endpoint, recalculates Bs. values in real-time when rate changes, supports manual override with amber styling, and shows grand totals in $ and Bs.

issues: React hydration warnings about span elements inside table elements (tr, tbody) - cosmetic issue from Emergent visual editor, does not affect functionality
Missing aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility warning, does not affect functionality

success_rate.backend: 100% - approve endpoint accepts billing instruction data and stores in MongoDB

seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing quote COT-2026-03-397-PYME (status: Enviada)
context_for_next_testing_agent: ApprovalBillingModal fully functional. Flow: Cotizaciones > Actions dropdown > Aprobación > Continuar (email dialog) > ApprovalBillingModal opens. Features: 1) Optional file upload for 'Comprobante de Pago Anticipado', 2) Consolidation table with Concepto/Cant./Monto($)/Tasa/Total(Bs.) columns, 3) Exchange rate auto-loads from /api/exchange-rate/current, 4) Changing rate recalculates all Bs. values, 5) Manual Bs. override turns input amber with warning message, 6) Total row shows grand totals, 7) Confirmar Aprobación button submits to POST /api/quotes/{id}/approve with billing_instruction data.
